001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
006import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
014import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
017import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
018import org.slf4j.Logger;
019import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
020
021/**
022 * XML Walker for applying transformations to XML data.
023 *
024 * <p>This command navigates through XML structures and applies transformations using rules while
025 * preserving the overall XML structure. It identifies specific elements using TreePath
026 * slash-delimited path expressions (e.g., {@code product/name}) and applies {@link IRule}
027 * transformations to the text content of matching nodes.
028 *
029 * <p>The full XML event stream — including the XML declaration, all elements, attributes, and text
030 * nodes — is written to the output. Only character data at nodes whose path exactly matches the
031 * configured {@link TreePath} is transformed by the rule; all other events are passed through
032 * unchanged.
033 */
034public class XmlWalker implements IStreamCommand {
035  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlWalker.class);
036
037  private final TreePath treePath;
038  private final IRule rule;
039
040  /**
041   * Constructor for XML navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
042   *
043   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
044   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
045   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
046   */
047  XmlWalker(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
048    if (treePath == null) {
049      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
050    }
051    if (rule == null) {
052      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
053    }
054    this.treePath = treePath;
055    this.rule = rule;
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with TreePath and rule.
060   *
061   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
062   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
063   * @return an XmlWalker that transforms the specified TreePath elements with the given rule
064   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
065   */
066  public static XmlWalker create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
067    if (treePath == null) {
068      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
069    }
070    if (rule == null) {
071      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
072    }
073    return new XmlWalker(treePath, rule);
074  }
075
076  @Override
077  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
078    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
079    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
080    IOException primaryException = null;
081
082    try {
083      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
084      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
085      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, treePath, rule);
086      eventWriter.flush();
087    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
088      primaryException = buildXmlException(e);
089    } finally {
090      primaryException = XmlStreamResources.closeAll(eventReader, eventWriter, primaryException);
091    }
092
093    if (primaryException != null) {
094      throw primaryException;
095    }
096  }
097
098  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
099  // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions; any RuntimeException must be caught and
100  // re-thrown as XMLStreamException so the caller's error-handling path is not bypassed.
101  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
102      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, TreePath treePath, IRule rule)
103      throws XMLStreamException {
104    XMLEventFactory eventFactory = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
105    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
106
107    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
108      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
109
110      if (event.isStartElement()) {
111        currentPath.add(event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart());
112      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
113        if (currentPath.isEmpty()) {
114          logger.warn(
115              "Unexpected end element '{}' with empty path stack — possible malformed XML",
116              event.asEndElement().getName().getLocalPart());
117        } else {
118          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
119        }
120      } else if (event.isCharacters() && treePath.matches(currentPath)) {
121        String data = event.asCharacters().getData();
122        String transformed;
123        try {
124          transformed = rule.apply(data);
125        } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
126          throw new XMLStreamException("Rule application failed at path " + currentPath, ruleEx);
127        }
128        // Write every event unconditionally; character events at the target path are replaced
129        // above.
130        event = eventFactory.createCharacters(transformed);
131      }
132
133      eventWriter.add(event);
134    }
135  }
136
137  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
138    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
139    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
140    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
141      try {
142        reader.close();
143      } catch (XMLStreamException closeEx) {
144        logger.warn("Failed to close empty XMLEventReader", closeEx);
145      }
146      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
147    }
148    return reader;
149  }
150
151  /**
152   * 出力ストリームへの XMLEventWriter を作成する。
153   *
154   * <p>テスト時にオーバーライドしてファクトリをモック可能にするため protected スコープとしている。
155   *
156   * @param outputStream 書き込み先ストリーム
157   * @return 設定済み XMLEventWriter
158   * @throws XMLStreamException ライターの生成に失敗した場合
159   */
160  protected XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(OutputStream outputStream)
161      throws XMLStreamException {
162    return SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLOutputFactory().createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
163  }
164
165  private IOException buildXmlException(XMLStreamException e) {
166    String location = "";
167    if (e.getLocation() != null) {
168      int line = e.getLocation().getLineNumber();
169      int column = e.getLocation().getColumnNumber();
170      if (line > 0 && column > 0) {
171        location = String.format(" at line %d, column %d", line, column);
172      }
173    }
174    logger.error("XML processing failed{}", location, e);
175    return new IOException("XML processing failed" + location, e);
176  }
177}
